title: Why Schools Should Start Later
text:
Many people think that school should start later in the morning. They believe that students need more sleep to learn well. Doctors say that teenagers often feel tired early in the day. When students sleep more, they usually pay more attention in class.

Some parents worry that a later start would make afternoons too long. However, schools could finish later in the day without any problem. Students could also use the extra morning time to exercise or eat a healthy breakfast. In the end, a small change could help students be happier and healthier.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do doctors say about teenagers?
options: They often feel tired early in the day.
They prefer to study at night.

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what could students do with the extra morning time?
options: Exercise or eat a healthy breakfast.
Take a long trip to school.

questions.text: Why does the writer think a later start is a good idea?
options: Students would be more awake and able to learn.
Parents would have no work to do.

questions.text: What is the writer's main purpose in this passage?
options: To persuade readers that schools should start later.
To explain how to build a new school.
To tell a story about a student's day.
To describe the history of breakfast.

vocabulary.definition: feeling that you need sleep or rest
to feel concerned that something bad might happen

paragraph_translations: Muchas personas piensan que la escuela debería empezar más tarde por la mañana. Creen que los estudiantes necesitan dormir más para aprender bien. Los médicos dicen que los adolescentes a menudo se sienten cansados temprano en el día. Cuando los estudiantes duermen más, normalmente prestan más atención en clase.

Algunos padres se preocupan de que un inicio más tarde haga que las tardes sean demasiado largas. Sin embargo, las escuelas podrían terminar más tarde en el día sin ningún problema. Los estudiantes también podrían usar el tiempo extra de la mañana para hacer ejercicio o desayunar de forma saludable. Al final, un cambio pequeño podría ayudar a los estudiantes a ser más felices y más sanos.
